question:
I am conducting a research project on the growth trajectory of female power and would like to know which women have won the award whose selection process must remain confidential for half a century, presented by an institution with 18 lifetime members established in the late 18th century, as well as their first three published works (both names and works should retain the original native language).

Please present the organized data in Markdown table format.
The column headers should be, in order:
Award Year, Name, Published Work, Year of First Publication.

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the column without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
